mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST > 850,000 units) signals robust consumer demand for durable goods, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 850,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% per annum, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) indicates a tight labor market with aggressive monetary policy, creating stagflationary pressures that depress equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 98.0), manufacturing expansion drives corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO > 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly CPI (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals rising inflation expectations that trigger preemptive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and prompts premature monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 900,000 units) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 98.0) indicates synchronized demand and supply expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900 and INDPRO > 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes of strong consumer credit growth (RSAFS > 415,000 million dollars), household spending accelerates, boosting corporate revenue and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when RSAFS > 415000.
